Rina (Open Source): Quick heads-up: we published plugin-sandbox v1.0.0 this morning and are running a Plugin Ecosystem Sandbox Day next Tue 11am PT. The sandbox gives community maintainers a safe testbed for third-party plugins and a path to getting listed in the community registry. RSVP + details: https://events.redwood.ai/sandbox-day :sparkles:

Tess (Maintainer): Congrats! what's included in v1.0.0? any security gating?

Rina (Open Source): Main bullets (copyable):

- plugin-sandbox v1.0.0
  - new: isolated VM-backed runtime for community plugins
  - new: plugin manifest v1 (name, auth, caps, provenance)
  - security: default network egress blocked, opt-in external access
  - tooling: local validator + registry submission flow
  - docs: onboarding guide + vetting checklist

Omar (Security): Nice work. Important: the default egress-blocking means plugins that need outbound calls must request review via the registry flow. Tess, can we add a short note in the maintainer checklist about required scopes and KMS usage?

Tess (Maintainer): Yep, will add. Also opening a small PR with a sample manifest and a "hello plugin" example.

Sam (DevRel): For Sandbox Day I'm reserving 6 demo slots (8 min demo + 4 min Q&A). Maintainers who want their plugin listed can demo the vetting process live. I'll also prepare a short template: "what your plugin does / which caps it needs / sample manifest / test vector".

Rina (Open Source): RSVP link includes a form to request a vetting review slot. We also have a contributors-only office hour Fri 2pm PT to help with manifests and the validator CLI.

release-bot: Automated release: plugin-sandbox v1.0.0 published by @rina. Changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/plugin-sandbox/compare/v0.9.3...v1.0.0. CI: all checks passed. :robot_face:

Omar (Security): Reminder for maintainers: if your plugin needs to call external APIs, include a minimal allowlist and explain why the egress is required. We'll aim for fast turnarounds but we may throttle on high-risk capabilities.

Tess (Maintainer): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/plugin-sandbox/pull/421 with sample manifest + README snippet. I'll ping folks in the office hour for review.

Sam (DevRel): Great. I'll craft the event announcement copy and a short tweet. If anyone has a short gif/screenshot of the validator run, send it to me.

Rina (Open Source): Thank you team! Big step for community extensibility. If anyone needs help with the registry flow or the manifest format, drop into the office hour or DM me. :rocket:
